name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Neutral-Grip Shoulder Press
steps: Bring one dumbbell beside your shoulder with the palm turned toward your ear and plant both feet evenly.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly so your torso stays upright and level.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended and your biceps is beside your ear.
Lower the dumbbell with control back to shoulder height, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Do not lean away from the working side or arch your lower back as you press overhead.
Keep your wrist stacked directly above your elbow throughout the movement.
